style.name: Retro-Futurist Editorial Infographic 复古未来主义编辑信息图
style.zhName: Retro-Futurist Editorial Infographic 复古未来主义编辑信息图
style.description: 暖白纸张、深海军蓝、铜橙与金色组成的复古未来主义新闻信息图系统，结合技术档案、数据面板、编辑插画和统一信息网格。

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界杯进入决赛前空窗，29国成立AI合作组织，单人创业占比创纪录
zh-CN.headlineView: 球场短暂停下来，技术、战争与制度仍在加速重排。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界杯进入决赛前空窗，29国成立AI合作组织，单人创业占比创纪录；球场短暂停下来，技术、战争与制度仍在加速重排。
zh-CN.intro: 本期世界杯窗口内没有完赛，西班牙与阿根廷已进入决赛。场外，29国签署协议成立全球AI合作机构；Stripe Atlas数据显示单人创业占比升至历史新高；美伊连续互袭并再次扰动霍尔木兹航运；乌克兰任命新总理；美国地方社会反对AI数据中心扩张；意大利推进选举法改革；油价反弹重新推高欧洲加息预期。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天8条新闻的共同点，是“规模变大之后，谁来承担代价”：AI要规则，创业要分销，战争要航道，数据中心要土地和电。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界杯休息一天，世界其他频道却一个都没暂停。

en-US.headlineFact: The World Cup pauses before the final, 29 countries form an AI body, and solo founding reaches a record share
en-US.headlineView: football briefly stops while technology, war and institutions keep accelerating.
en-US.headlineFull: The World Cup pauses before the final, 29 countries form an AI body, and solo founding reaches a record share; football briefly stops while technology, war and institutions keep accelerating.
en-US.intro: No World Cup match finished inside today’s reporting window, while Spain and Argentina await the final. Beyond football, 29 countries formed a global AI cooperation body, solo founding reached a record share, U.S.-Iran fighting disrupted Hormuz again, Ukraine appointed a new prime minister, American communities pushed back against AI data centers, Italy advanced electoral reform, and rising oil prices revived European rate-hike expectations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today’s eight stories share one question: after systems scale, who carries the cost? AI needs rules, startups need distribution, war needs sea lanes, and data centers need land and power.
en-US.doudouQuote: Football took a day off, but every other channel in the world kept running.

sources.title: The World Cup pauses before the final, 29 countries form an AI body, and solo founding reaches a record share

zh-CN.headlineFact: 窗口内没有完赛，西班牙与阿根廷等待决赛
zh-CN.headlineView: 没有哨声的24小时，是终局前最后一次集体喘息。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 窗口内没有完赛，西班牙与阿根廷等待决赛；没有哨声的24小时，是终局前最后一次集体喘息。
zh-CN.intro: 北京时间7月16日05:00至7月17日05:00没有世界杯比赛完赛。最近一场半决赛在窗口开始前结束：阿根廷2:1击败英格兰，与西班牙会师决赛。季军赛为法国对英格兰，决赛为西班牙对阿根廷。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 决赛前的空窗不是没有内容，而是所有战术、体能和情绪都在暗处重新计算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天没有比分更新，球迷的任务只有两个：补觉，以及继续猜冠军。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：世界杯日报。

en-US.headlineFact: No World Cup match is completed in the reporting window as Spain and Argentina await the final
en-US.headlineView: the quiet 24 hours are the tournament’s last collective reset before the finish.
en-US.headlineFull: No World Cup match is completed in the reporting window as Spain and Argentina await the final; the quiet 24 hours are the tournament’s last collective reset before the finish.
en-US.intro: No World Cup match was completed between 05:00 on July 16 and 05:00 on July 17 Beijing time. Argentina’s 2–1 semi-final victory over England finished before the window, setting up a final against Spain. France and England will contest the third-place playoff.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A quiet day before the final is not empty at all—tactics, fitness, and emotion are all being recalculated out of sight.
en-US.doudouQuote: No score update today, so fans have only two jobs: catch up on sleep and keep guessing the champion.

sources.title: No World Cup match is completed in the reporting window as Spain and Argentina await the final

zh-CN.headlineFact: 29国签署协议成立世界人工智能合作组织
zh-CN.headlineView: AI竞争开始从模型榜单，走向谁来制定全球规则。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 29国签署协议成立世界人工智能合作组织；AI竞争开始从模型榜单，走向谁来制定全球规则。
zh-CN.intro: 包括俄罗斯、巴西、塞尔维亚以及多个亚洲、非洲国家在内的29国签署协议，成立“世界人工智能合作组织”。该机构总部将设在上海，目标是推动人工智能国际合作与全球治理，并在上海世界人工智能大会前正式亮相。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI下半场不只比谁的模型更强，也比谁能把自己的技术理念写进国际规则。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 以前AI开会讨论参数，现在已经开始讨论“谁负责管全世界的参数”。

en-US.headlineFact: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization
en-US.headlineView: AI competition is shifting from model rankings to who gets to shape global rules.
en-US.headlineFull: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization; AI competition is shifting from model rankings to who gets to shape global rules.
en-US.intro: Twenty-nine countries signed an agreement to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization, an intergovernmental body intended to promote international cooperation and global AI governance. Its headquarters will be based in Shanghai.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The next phase of AI competition is not only about stronger models, but also about whose ideas get written into international rules.
en-US.doudouQuote: AI meetings used to debate parameters; now they are starting to debate who gets to govern the world’s parameters.

sources.title: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization

zh-CN.headlineFact: Stripe Atlas第二季度新设公司中，单人创始人占63%
zh-CN.headlineView: 一个人更容易开公司了，但更容易成立不等于更容易成功。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Stripe Atlas第二季度新设公司中，单人创始人占63%；一个人更容易开公司了，但更容易成立不等于更容易成功。
zh-CN.intro: Stripe Atlas数据显示，2026年第二季度迄今，其协助成立的美国C类公司中，63%没有联合创始人，创历史新高。不过，头部与普通单人公司的收入差距也在扩大：2025年头部一成公司的早期收入约为中位数公司的61倍。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI让一个人拥有过去一个团队的生产力，但真正的壁垒正在转向选题、信任、分销和复购。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一个人可以当老板、产品、设计和客服，但最好别顺便当24小时不下班的机器人。

en-US.headlineFact: Solo founders account for 63% of new Stripe Atlas companies in the second quarter
en-US.headlineView: incorporating alone is easier, but easier formation does not mean easier success.
en-US.headlineFull: Solo founders account for 63% of new Stripe Atlas companies in the second quarter; incorporating alone is easier, but easier formation does not mean easier success.
en-US.intro: Solo founders accounted for 63% of C corporations formed through Stripe Atlas so far in the second quarter of 2026, an all-time high. At the same time, the revenue gap is widening: top-decile solo startups generated about 61 times the early revenue of the median company in 2025.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI gives one person the productivity of a former team, but the real moat is shifting toward ideas, trust, distribution, and repeat purchase.
en-US.doudouQuote: One person can start a company, but one person should not have to carry every role forever. Borrow tools, and also borrow people and networks.

sources.title: Solo founders account for 63% of new Stripe Atlas companies in the second quarter

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美伊连续第六夜互袭，霍尔木兹航运再次大幅停滞
zh-CN.headlineView: 世界经济最脆弱的开关，仍藏在少数关键海峡里。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美伊连续第六夜互袭，霍尔木兹航运再次大幅停滞；世界经济最脆弱的开关，仍藏在少数关键海峡里。
zh-CN.intro: 美国表示连续第六夜打击伊朗军事目标，伊朗则以导弹和无人机攻击邻国境内的美军基地。持续一周的升级已大幅瓦解上月停火安排，并使霍尔木兹海峡交通再次基本停顿，全球能源价格随之上升。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 战争看起来发生在远方，最终却会通过油价、运费、通胀和利率进入每个人的生活。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 霍尔木兹一堵车，全世界的账单都开始排队涨价。

en-US.headlineFact: A sixth consecutive night of U.S.-Iran strikes stalls Hormuz shipping again
en-US.headlineView: the world economy’s most fragile switches still sit inside a few strategic straits.
en-US.headlineFull: A sixth consecutive night of U.S.-Iran strikes stalls Hormuz shipping again; the world economy’s most fragile switches still sit inside a few strategic straits.
en-US.intro: The United States carried out a sixth consecutive night of strikes on Iranian targets, while Iran launched missiles and drones at U.S. bases in neighboring countries. The escalation has largely unraveled last month’s truce and again severely disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
en-US.xiaziQuote: War may look far away, but it reaches everyday life through oil prices, freight rates, inflation, and interest rates.
en-US.doudouQuote: When Hormuz gets jammed, the whole world’s bills line up to get more expensive.

sources.title: A sixth consecutive night of U.S.-Iran strikes stalls Hormuz shipping again

zh-CN.headlineFact: 乌克兰议会任命能源高管科列茨基为新总理
zh-CN.headlineView: 战时政府换帅，最先要守住的是能源、经济与民众信心。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 乌克兰议会任命能源高管科列茨基为新总理；战时政府换帅，最先要守住的是能源、经济与民众信心。
zh-CN.intro: 乌克兰议会以289票支持，任命前国家能源公司Naftogaz首席执行官谢尔希·科列茨基为总理，这是俄罗斯全面入侵以来乌克兰第三位总理。科列茨基表示，国防、经济稳定和融入欧盟将是政府的主要任务。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 让能源管理者在战争中接管政府，说明乌克兰面对的不只是前线压力，还有下一轮冬季与经济韧性。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 战时总理的待办事项，大概从“保住电网”一直排到“加入欧盟”。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：乌克兰政局。

en-US.headlineFact: Ukraine appoints energy executive Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister
en-US.headlineView: a wartime leadership change puts energy, economic resilience, and public confidence first.
en-US.headlineFull: Ukraine appoints energy executive Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister; a wartime leadership change puts energy, economic resilience, and public confidence first.
en-US.intro: Ukraine’s parliament appointed former Naftogaz chief Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister with 289 votes. He is the country’s third prime minister since Russia’s full-scale invasion and named defense, economic stability and European integration as his priorities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Choosing an energy manager to lead a country at war shows that Ukraine is facing not only front-line pressure, but also the next winter and its economic resilience.
en-US.doudouQuote: A wartime prime minister’s to-do list probably runs from keeping the grid alive all the way to joining the EU.

sources.title: Ukraine appoints energy executive Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister

zh-CN.headlineFact: 160亿美元AI数据中心引爆美国小镇反对，只有14%受访者愿意在社区附近建设
zh-CN.headlineView: 算力越宏大，地方成本越无法隐藏。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 160亿美元AI数据中心引爆美国小镇反对，只有14%受访者愿意在社区附近建设；算力越宏大，地方成本越无法隐藏。
zh-CN.intro: 密歇根州人口约2400人的萨林镇正在建设一座占地超过250英亩、投资160亿美元的AI数据中心，引发土地、用水和资源争议。Reuters/Ipsos调查显示，仅14%的美国受访者支持在自己的社区建设数据中心。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI看起来在云端，真正落地时却要占土地、接电网、用水，并与当地居民重新谈判利益分配。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 人人都想要更聪明的AI，但数据中心最好建在“别人家隔壁”。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：美国基础设施。

en-US.headlineFact: A $16 billion AI data center sparks backlash in a small American town
en-US.headlineView: the larger compute becomes, the harder its local land, power, and water costs are to hide.
en-US.headlineFull: A $16 billion AI data center sparks backlash in a small American town; the larger compute becomes, the harder its local land, power, and water costs are to hide.
en-US.intro: A $16 billion AI data-center project spanning more than 250 acres has turned a small Michigan farming community into a national flashpoint. A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that only 14% of Americans would support a data center being built in their own community.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI may seem to live in the cloud, but when it lands, it takes land, grid capacity, and water—and forces a new negotiation with local residents.
en-US.doudouQuote: Everyone wants smarter AI, but most people still hope the data center gets built next to somebody else’s home.

sources.title: A $16 billion AI data center sparks backlash in a small American town

zh-CN.headlineFact: 意大利众议院通过争议选举法改革
zh-CN.headlineView: “保证稳定多数”的制度设计，也可能变成执政者延长优势的工具。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 意大利众议院通过争议选举法改革；“保证稳定多数”的制度设计，也可能变成执政者延长优势的工具。
zh-CN.intro: 意大利众议院以217票对152票通过选举法改革方案。新制度拟取消部分简单多数制席位，全面转向比例代表制，并向全国得票超过42%的联盟追加席位。反对派指责改革有利于梅洛尼政府，法案仍需参议院批准。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 选举制度从来不是中性的计算公式，规则怎么设计，往往会提前改变下一场比赛的起跑线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 还没开始投票，大家先为“怎么算赢”吵起来了。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：意大利政治。

en-US.headlineFact: Italy’s lower house passes a contested electoral reform bill
en-US.headlineView: rules designed to guarantee a stable majority can also extend an incumbent’s advantage.
en-US.headlineFull: Italy’s lower house passes a contested electoral reform bill; rules designed to guarantee a stable majority can also extend an incumbent’s advantage.
en-US.intro: Italy’s lower house approved a contested electoral reform by 217 votes to 152. The proposal would introduce a fully proportional system and grant extra seats to a coalition winning more than 42% nationally. It still requires Senate approval.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Electoral rules are never neutral math. The way a system is designed often changes the starting line of the next contest before voting begins.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before the ballots even arrive, everyone is already arguing about how winning should be counted.

sources.title: Italy’s lower house passes a contested electoral reform bill

zh-CN.headlineFact: 油价反弹约20%，欧洲央行9月加息预期升温
zh-CN.headlineView: 能源冲突最远的回声，往往出现在家庭贷款与企业成本里。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 油价反弹约20%，欧洲央行9月加息预期升温；能源冲突最远的回声，往往出现在家庭贷款与企业成本里。
zh-CN.intro: Reuters对74名经济学家的调查显示，受中东冲突推动油价近期上涨约20%的影响，所有受访者预计欧洲央行7月23日维持利率不变，但约70%预计年内还将加息一次，多数判断时间可能在9月。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一场能源冲突不仅影响加油站，也会通过通胀预期，改变房贷、融资和企业扩张计划。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 海峡那边油价一涨，欧洲这边房贷先紧张起来。

en-US.headlineFact: Oil’s 20% rebound lifts expectations of a September ECB rate hike
en-US.headlineView: the farthest echo of an energy shock often reaches household loans and business financing.
en-US.headlineFull: Oil’s 20% rebound lifts expectations of a September ECB rate hike; the farthest echo of an energy shock often reaches household loans and business financing.
en-US.intro: All 74 economists in a Reuters poll expect the European Central Bank to hold rates on July 23, but roughly 70% anticipate another increase this year, most likely in September, as a renewed energy-price surge revives inflation risks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An energy conflict does not stop at the gas station. Through inflation expectations, it reshapes mortgages, financing, and corporate expansion plans.
en-US.doudouQuote: Oil rises near a distant strait, and suddenly mortgages and business costs start to tense up in Europe.

sources.title: Oil’s 20% rebound lifts expectations of a September ECB rate hike
